escena: SCENE (the glass entrance door of Efeonce's office, Santiago, at blue hour just after sunset): a tight, frontal, eye-level view of a tall FRAMELESS clear-glass door, the camera square to the glass so the door plane is flat and parallel to the sensor. Mounted on the glass, right of centre, is a long VERTICAL PULL BAR in matte black anodised aluminium, a slim rod that obviously invites you to grab it and PULL. A single right hand, entering from the right edge with a charcoal-grey merino knit sleeve, grips the bar firmly mid-pull, knuckles tensed, the moment of pulling a door that will not open. Only the hand and the forearm enter the frame. To the LEFT of the bar, at the same hand height, the glass is clean, empty and smooth for a hand's width, with no sticker, no sign, no letters, no symbols and no marks on it. Through the glass, the office behind is dark and quiet: the floor-to-ceiling windows at the back show the city at blue hour, a deep ink-navy sky with tiny far-out-of-focus city lights, the room itself unlit, contemporary and bare, a polished dark concrete floor, and at the very back, far out of focus, a single slim wall screen glowing a saturated cobalt blue, the one coloured light inside the room, its glow reflected as a soft blue streak on the floor. The only cool fill comes from the blue-hour windows; a narrow hard key light from a low recessed spot outside the frame on the right rakes across the hand and the bar, leaving the rest in shadow. The whole frame is cool and contemporary: nothing is warm, amber, orange or golden. The bar and the hand sit in the lower-middle of the picture; the upper third of the frame is the dark glass reflecting nothing but the ink-navy sky, one smooth unbroken field with no lamp, no window frame and no bright spot in it. 85mm lens at f/2.8.

texto.muro: the dark glass in the upper third reflecting only the ink-navy blue-hour sky

lecho.objeto: the door's wide matte-black steel kick plate running across the bottom edge of the glass
lecho.tono: DARK matte black steel in shadow, its fine brushed grain barely visible
